verdict.rationale: The pack holds verbatim text from several canada.ca guidance pages (business registration, e-services, EFILE, the CRA home page), which shows the public reading surface was retrieved as readable content. The canada.ca probe also returned a plain HTTP 302 with no challenge page, though that request was for llms.txt rather than a guidance page. No probe directly records an agent with an identified user agent getting HTTP 200 on a guidance page, and none confirms the absence of a bot wall, JS-only shell or CAPTCHA. Missing for 10: a direct fetch probe of a guidance page showing 200 with server-rendered HTML and an identified UA, explicit confirmation that no bot-protection or CAPTCHA is in front, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface

citations.quote: Registering online is the fastest and easiest way to get a business number (BN) and certain CRA program accounts such as GST/HST and payroll.
